questions.question: Which of the following chemical compound is used as a yeast de-foaming agent, commonly found in butter, meat, cereals, chewing gum, baked goods, snack foods, dehydrated potatoes and beer?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Butylated hydroxyanisole.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Butylated Hydroxyanisole is a white, waxy solid** combination of 2- and 3-tert-butyl-4-hydroxyanisole that has a slight aromatic odour.
 
• It is largely utilised as an** antioxidant and preservative **in food, food packaging, animal feed, cosmetics, as well as rubber and petroleum industries

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Benzene hexachloride** is used in agriculture, forestry, and seed treatment. It's used to get rid of head and body lice. It is utilised in the pharmaceutical industry.
 
• **Chlorobenzoate is a chlorobenzoate** derivative of 3-chlorobenzoic acid. It is structurally similar to a benzoate. This whitish substance is a precursor of **several medications, food additives, and colours.**
 
• **Potassium Nitrate** is a crystalline powder or solid that is clear, **white, or colourless and has a strong, salty flavour.**

questions.question: Under which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India is the provision that no person shall be prosecuted and punished for the same offence more than once laid down?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __'**Article 20**'__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 20** in the Constitution of India provides **Protection in respect of conviction of offences.**
 
• No person shall be convicted of any offence except for violation of the law in force at the time of the commission of the act charged as an offence, nor be subjected to a penalty greater than that which might have been inflicted under the law in force at the time of the commission of the offence.
 
• **No person shall be prosecuted and punished for the same offence more than once laid down.**
 
• No person accused of any offence shall be compelled to be a witness against himself.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 17**, Abolition of Untouchability and its practice in any form is forbidden. The enforcement of any disability arising out shall be an offence and punishable in accordance with the law.
 
• **Article 18**, of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, says we all have the right to our own beliefs, to have a religion, have no religion, or to change it.
 
• **Article 19**, Freedom of Speech and Expression, provides freedom of speech which is the right to express one's opinion freely without any fear through oral/written/electronic/broadcasting/press.

questions.question: Identify the statement that is true for London forces.

options.text: These forces are always attractive, and the interaction energy is directly proportional to the sixth power of the distance between two interacting particles.
These forces are always attractive, and the interaction energy is inversely proportional to the second power of the distance between two interacting particles.
These forces are always attractive, and the interaction energy is inversely proportional to the sixth power of the distance between two interacting particles.
These forces are non-attractive, and the interaction energy is directly proportional to the sixth power of the distance between two interacting particles.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is "__**These forces are always attractive, and the interaction energy is inversely proportional to the sixth power of the distance between two interacting particles".**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **London forces** are defined as a **temporary attractive force** due to the formation of **temporary dipoles** in a non-polar molecule.
 
• The **forces** are always **attractive**, and the interaction energy of **London force **propto (1)/(6) of the distance between two **interacting particles**.
 
• The attractive forces cause nonpolar substances to condense to liquids and to freeze into solids when the temperature is lowered sufficiently.
 
• **Larger** the molecules, **higher** is the magnitude of London forces because larger electron clouds are polarised. So, their magnitude depends on the polarisability of the particle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• London forces are important only at short distances (~500pm) and their magnitude depends on the polarisability of the particle.
 
• The larger, the molecular size, the more the polarisability and more would be the strength of dispersion.
 
• Potential energy is negative when the forces are attractive in nature. Therefore, potential energy is inversely proportional to intermolecular force of attraction.

questions.question: The Green Revolution in India was initiated by MS Swaminathan in ________.

• The Green Revolution is referred to as a period when Indian agriculture was converted to an industrial system due to the adoption of modern methods and technologies.
 
• It included the use of products like High-Yielding variety seeds, tractors, irrigation facilities, pesticides, and fertilizers which were not used or used very limitedly.
 
• Indian agriculture made a transition from old manual methods to new, innovative, and technological methods.
 
• The movement of the green revolution was a great success that changed the country's status from a food-deficient economy to one of the world's leading agricultural nations.
 
• This revolution led to an increase in food grain production, in Punjab, Haryana, and Uttar Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Norman Borlaug was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 1970 for his contribution to saving over 1 billion people worldwide from dying of starvation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chief Minister of state holds a position of power in the state.
 
• He is the head of the State Council of Ministers and the real executive head of state government.
 
• According to the article of the Indian Constitution 164, the chief minister is appointed by the governor.
 
• For all practical purposes, the Chief Minister holds the executive power of the State Government in his hands.
 
 
• Formation of the Ministry.
 
• Distribution of Portfolios.
 
• Removal of Ministers.
 
• Chairman of the cabinet.
 
• Leader of the Legislature
 
 
 
• If the CM dies or resigns, the council automatically dissolves.

**Article related to Chief Minister:**

 
• **Article 163: **The Council of Ministers should aid and advise the governor
 
• **Article 164: **Other provisions as to minister.
 
• **Article 167: **Duties of Chief Minister regarding furnishing information to the governor.

questions.question: To which type of vegetation do Silver fir, junipers, pines and birches belong commonly in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Montane forests.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Montane Forest** is an ecosystem found in **mountains.**it gets affected by colder climates at moderate elevations.
 
• The **Alpine vegetation** includes trees like **silver fir**, **junipers**, **pines**, and **birches.**they get progressively stunted as they approach the snowline, and through shrubs and scrubs, they merge into the Alpine grasslands.
 
• Between **1500 and 3000 **meters, temperature forests contain coniferous trees like **pine**, **deodar**, and **silver fir**.
 
• They primarily cover the Southern slopes of the Himalayas, as well as high-altitude areas in southern and northeastern India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Montane forests** can be found in high-altitude areas such as the Himalayas.
 
• Trees are conical in shape in these areas. 
 
• These are dense forests at moderate elevation, because of moderate temperatures and high rainfall dense mountain forests are common at moderate elevation.
 
• At higher elevations, the vegetation transformed into tundra or grasslands.

questions.question: As of January 2022, which of the following Indian festivals is the latest to be inscribed in the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Durga Puja.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Durga Puja** is an annual **festival** celebrated in September or October, most notably in **Kolkata**, in **West Bengal of India**, and also in other parts of India amongst the **Bengalis**.
 
• This festival is the latest to be inscribed in the **UNESCO Representative list** of the **intangible cultural heritage of humanity**, in **December 2021**.
 
• The **event** was held to celebrate the marking of the UNESCO tag awarded at the **National Museum, New Delhi** in the presence of top officials of UNESCO.
 
• **Durga Puja** received the honour during UNESCO's **16th session** held in **Paris, France**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNESCO** - The United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.
 
• India was recently elected as one of the members of the UNESCO Intergovernmental Committee for the Safeguarding of Intangible Cultural Heritage.
 
• **Tim Curtis** - Secretary of UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage.
 
• **Eric Falt -** Director and UNESCO Representative for the UNESCO New Delhi Office.
 
• UNESCO headquarters in Paris, France.
